commentary.text: I’m claiming a central square immediately while blocking Blue’s direct approach along row 4 and setting up Yellow to contest the remaining center.
I’m claiming the right-center square while keeping the left-center square accessible to Green, setting up a coordinated center occupation.
Yellow takes a central square, establishing a direct center-occupation threat alongside Red at (4,4) and forcing Team B to respond defensively.
Yellow has blocked our planned upper-center pair, so Green takes the open lower-left center. This keeps direct center pressure and forces Red and Yellow to defend both central ranks.
I flank the advanced Green piece with Red, removing it while strengthening our hold around the center.
Blue uses the existing piece at (3,4) as the far flank: landing below Red’s central piece completes a vertical sandwich and removes a key center defender.
I’m using the advanced Yellow piece at (3,3) as the far flank, capturing Blue’s central piece while strengthening Yellow’s presence near the center.
Green develops onto column 4, preparing to enter the vacant upper-right center square next turn. The piece is also positioned away from Red’s horizontal pair on row 4.
I’m taking a central square with Red, building alongside Yellow’s piece at (3,3) while blocking Blue’s direct route across row 4.
Blue shifts toward column 3, preparing to enter the remaining lower-left center square. Together with Green’s planned move to (3,4), this rebuilds coordinated pressure on all four central squares.
Yellow consolidates the center, occupying a third central square for Team A while preserving the existing Red foothold.

Green steps beside the Blue piece on column 4, preparing a discovered vertical sandwich. If Blue vacates (5,4), Green can land there with the Green at (2,4) as the far flank, capturing the intervening Yellow and Red pieces together.
I complete Team A’s occupation of all four central squares, securing an immediate center victory.

Team A is one move from completing the center, so Blue must occupy (4,4). Using the edge piece keeps the Blue at (5,4) directly behind it, preventing Yellow from forming the obvious vertical sandwich.
I’m shifting Yellow one square inward, preserving open lanes while avoiding the occupied destination from the rejected move.

Green completes the prepared vertical flank from above. The Green at (5,3) closes the line, so this move sandwiches and captures both Yellow at (3,3) and Red at (4,3), breaking Team A’s center formation.
I’m developing Red toward the center beside Yellow, creating a mobile central formation while avoiding any immediate sandwich exposure.
Blue attacks the other central column immediately. Landing at (2,4) uses the Blue piece at (4,4) as the far flank, sandwiching Yellow’s center piece and bringing Yellow to two losses.
I’m aligning Yellow’s pieces against the Blue piece on (6,3). This threatens a same-color sandwich from (6,4), forcing Blue to spend its next turn moving that piece or lose it.
Green occupies (3,4), sealing Red’s piece on the right out of the upper center. With Blue already at (4,4), our two remaining Green pieces on column 3 can advance into the other center squares.
I’m advancing Red toward the open center lane, threatening to move onto (3,3) and sandwich the Green piece at (3,4) against Red at (3,5).

Blue reinforces column 3 and blocks Red’s piece at (0,3) from descending through that file. This preserves the route for Green to fill the two remaining center squares while keeping our current center pair intact.
I’m closing a Yellow sandwich along row 6, using the Yellow piece at (6,2) as the far flank to capture Blue at (6,3).

Green takes the lower-left center, giving Team B three central squares. Red can contest the last square, but this move preserves our pieces and forces an immediate defensive response instead of allowing a two-piece sandwich on the upper row.
I’m advancing Red into the center while sandwiching the Green piece on (3,4) against Red on (3,5). This secures one central square and weakens Green without exposing Red to an immediate capture.
